intent.proves: At least one user group holds a Read-or-higher grant on a shop, limiting order-management data to permitted shops.
intent.scope: UnifiedPermission rows with PermissionName Shop and a group principal

bindings.reason: Admin permission read verb named in dw-data-access recipes; response projection not measured.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UnifiedPermission WHERE PermissionName = 'Shop' AND PermissionLevel >= 4 AND PermissionUserId NOT IN ('Anonymous','AuthenticatedFrontend','Administrator')
